shm.text: Mistmeadow is a kithkin doun endangered by the approach of Rosheen Meanderer, and Maralen's offer of protection is repelled by Donal Alloway of Kinscaer.
Jack Chierdagh is sent to retrieve an item of Rosheen's to drive her away, and the faeries help him by stealing her scroll, so she leaves and Jack becomes the Hero of Mistmeadow.

Many Mistmeadowers take Alloway's offer and move to Kinscaer, while the rest stay, and when Ashling the Destroyer attacks, Brigid Baeli's brigade limits the damage and Vigilant Eidren sacrifices himself to hurl her from the doun.
Following Oona's defeat, Mistmeadow briefly returns to its Goldmeadow form.
